create_optimizer: create an RWSAdagrad optimizer instance with custom learning rate and weight decay for model parameters
run_optimization_step: run a single optimization step using the RWSAdagrad optimizer to update model parameters with sparse gradients
configure_lr_decay: configure the RWSAdagrad optimizer with learning rate decay to reduce step size over training iterations
share_memory_state: share the RWSAdagrad optimizer state across processes for multi-process training with sparse and dense gradients
review_sparse_gradient_update: review the RWSAdagrad step method to understand how row-wise sparse gradient updates are computed and applied
